bod-p01-v01.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p01-v01.question: What never sets, and who dwells within it?
premises: Never-setting light-form of bright powers and darknesses — darkness included, not opposed (api).
One within, in whom powers and darknesses end (yadantaḥ: limit and abode both).
bod-p01-v01.inference: The all-containing One: light that never sets, holding bright and dark.
uncertainties: yadantaḥ read as limit and abode both — verse lets both stand.

bod-p02-v02.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p02-v02.question: Who is own-nature of all beings?
premises: He alone is beings' own-nature, the supreme Lord (eva in identity).
Therefore the whole host of things is His power, shaped as Lordship (īśvaratāmayī: form, not second entity).
bod-p02-v02.inference: Identity, not process: He alone beings' nature; all things His Lordship-shaped power.
uncertainties: īśvaratāmayī read as power's form, not a second entity.

bod-p03-v03.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p03-v03.question: Does power ever part from her bearer?
premises: Power wants no apartness from the power-bearer (na vāñchati: will, not mechanism).
Eternal identity of the two — sealed by fire-and-burning only ground offered.
bod-p03-v03.inference: No-desire-for-difference, then eternal identity; fire-burning seals it.
uncertainties: na vāñchati personifies non-separation as will — kept as stated.

bod-p04-v04.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p04-v04.question: How does Bhairava bear the world?
premises: He alone Bhairava, world-bearing-marked; reflection by power His manner (no emanation language).
Vision itself the mirror (svātmādṛś); no reflecting agent besides power named.
bod-p04-v04.inference: Character then mechanism: world-bearing mark, power-mirroring manner.

bod-p05-v05.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p05-v05.question: Whose is the goddess, and what does she want?
premises: His alone the supreme goddess, eager only for own-nature-grasping (desire bounded as granted).
Exact fullness in all beings: neither little nor excess (definition of pūrṇatva).
uncertainties: utsukā appetite bounded to grasping; exactness not approximation.

bod-p06-v06.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p06-v06.question: What do god and goddess do together?
premises: Always play-joy-eager (mood); varied creation-dissolution at once (act).
Simultaneity needs ubiquity: yugapad load-bearing, vibhuḥ closing.
bod-p06-v06.inference: Mood then act: play-eager, therefore co-occurrent making-unmaking, everywhere.
uncertainties: yugapad unsoftened (co-occur, not alternate); vibhuḥ required by it.

bod-p07-v07.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p07-v07.question: What five names share one referent?
premises: Hard-to-accomplish of it, unsurpassed indeed (rank, not task).
Equation: that itself autonomy, lordship, awareness-form — no agent, no verb beyond is.
bod-p07-v07.inference: Five terms, one referent: hard = unsurpassed = autonomy = lordship = awareness-form.

bod-p08-v08.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p08-v08.question: How is awareness told apart from the inert?
premises: Limited light defines inert (mark); unmeasured awareness differs (reason: not measured).
na parimīyate active (evades measure); kila shared ground, no irony.
bod-p08-v08.inference: Mark then difference: partial shining vs measure-evading awareness.

bod-p09-v09.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p09-v09.question: Where do makings and unmakings stand?
premises: Autonomous by own-power-distinction; creations stand as own nature, gone to own self (arrival-without-departure, durative stand).
bod-p09-v09.inference: Thus-therefore: self-abiding change, stood not made.

bod-p10-v10.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p10-v10.question: How far does variety run?
premises: Teṣu back to verse 9's makings (inventory, no explaining).
Three directions, outer worlds-and-parts, inner pleasure-pain-mind — one list, no inner/outer split (Academy variant atir-bhavaḥ noted).
bod-p10-v10.inference: Total inventory, uncompressed: completeness is the point.
uncertainties: teṣu anaphoric; inner-outer undivided; Academy variant logged.

bod-p11-v11.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice, moral edge)
bod-p11-v11.question: What is bondage?
premises: Non-knowledge of this = autonomy described (hi emphasis, equation over explanation).
That itself = saṃsāra, terrifying to fools only (vibhīṣaka bounds the dread).
bod-p11-v11.inference: Equation then identification: mis-knowing is freedom; bondage dreadful-to-fools.
uncertainties: hi emphatic; dread bounded to fools (autonomy itself unterrifying).

bod-p12-v12.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p12-v12.question: By which doors is arrival reached?
premises: Three doors unranked: grace-sap, teacher-scripture, Lord's scripture.
yasmāt kasmāt indifferent to route; upāgatam content unnamed (verse 13 names it).
bod-p12-v12.inference: Three entries, one arrival, no hierarchy.

bod-p13-v13.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p13-v13.question: What is release?
premises: Four-term identity (not stages): full knowledge = liberation = fullness = living liberation.
parameśataḥ source-and-domain; sā smṛtā transmission-close.
bod-p13-v13.inference: Knowing is release, lived, remembered — no sequencing.

bod-p14-v14.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
bod-p14-v14.question: Do bondage and release differ?
premises: Pair from Lord's nature; doubled negation (na bhidyete, na bhedo hi) is emphasis.
tattvataḥ reconciles by level (verse 11's dread stands phenomenally); pure position, no practice.
bod-p14-v14.inference: Double non-difference: of the pair, and in the Lord, in truth.

bod-p15-v15.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice, closing injunction)
bod-p15-v15.question: Upon what is Bhairava to be dwelt?
premises: Emblem: will-art-knowledge-power trident-lotus seat, unexpanded lotus symbolism.
Closing word restates verse 2 (sarvabhāva own-nature); passive enjoins ongoing dwelling (SOURCE short-a variant noted).
bod-p15-v15.inference: Emblem then injunction: trident-lotus Bhairava, all-nature, to be dwelt upon.
uncertainties: Lotus unexpanded; dwelling-not-rite; short-a variant logged.

bod-p01-v01.plain_english: Of unsetting sun-light is His form — of bright powers and of darknesses too. For He is one, within, and powers and darknesses end in Him.
bod-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api | ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca

bod-p02-v02.plain_english: He alone is the own-nature of all beings, the supreme Lord. And the whole host of things is His alone — power, shaped as Lordship.
bod-p02-v02.sanskrit_cite: sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ svabhāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ | bhāvajātaṃ hi tasyaiva śaktir īśvaratāmayī

bod-p03-v03.plain_english: Power wants no apartness from the power-bearer. The two are eternally one — as fire is one with its burning.
bod-p03-v03.sanskrit_cite: śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati | tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva

bod-p04-v04.plain_english: He alone is Bhairava, the god whose very mark is bearing the world. In the mirror of His own self-seeing, the whole stands reflected — by power.
bod-p04-v04.sanskrit_cite: sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ | svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam

bod-p05-v05.plain_english: His alone is the supreme goddess, hungry only to grasp His own nature. She is fullness in all beings — in whom there is neither too little nor too much.
bod-p05-v05.sanskrit_cite: tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā | pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam

bod-p06-v06.plain_english: This god, with this goddess, is forever eager for the joy of play. Varied makings and unmakings He works at once — everywhere at once.
bod-p06-v06.sanskrit_cite: eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ | vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ

bod-p07-v07.plain_english: What is hardest to do is His, and it is unsurpassed. That itself is His freedom, His lordship, His awareness-form.
bod-p07-v07.sanskrit_cite: atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat | etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā

bod-p08-v08.plain_english: To shine only in part — that is the mark of the inert. Awareness is otherwise than the inert, for no measure contains it.
bod-p08-v08.sanskrit_cite: paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam | jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate

bod-p09-v09.plain_english: So it is with the free one, distinguishing by His own power: makings and unmakings rest in His own self, standing as His very nature.
bod-p09-v09.sanskrit_cite: evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ | svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ

bod-p10-v10.plain_english: In them, variety runs to the extreme — upward, downward, across. Worlds and their fragments, pleasure and pain and mind.
bod-p10-v10.sanskrit_cite: teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat | bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā

bod-p11-v11.plain_english: Not to know this is called His freedom. And that is saṃsāra itself — a terror to the deluded.
bod-p11-v11.sanskrit_cite: yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam | sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ

bod-p12-v12.plain_english: From the sap of His grace, or from the teacher's handed word, or from the Lord's own scripture — from whichever, it is reached.
bod-p12-v12.sanskrit_cite: tatprasādarasād eva gurvāgamata eva vā | śāstrād vā parameśasya yasmāt kasmād upāgatam

bod-p13-v13.plain_english: To know reality through and through — that is release, from the supreme Lord. That is the fullness of the awakened: freedom while living, as the remembered teaching holds.
bod-p13-v13.sanskrit_cite: yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ | tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā

bod-p14-v14.plain_english: Bondage and release both come of the Lord's own nature. The two do not split apart; in truth, in the supreme Lord, there is no split.
bod-p14-v14.sanskrit_cite: etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ | na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare

bod-p15-v15.plain_english: So it is: resting on the lotus of the trident — will, art, knowledge, power — Bhairava, the own-nature of all things, is to be dwelt upon.
bod-p15-v15.sanskrit_cite: ittham icchākalājñānaśaktiśūlāmbujāśritaḥ | bhairavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ pariśīlyate

essence: Unsetting light holds bright and dark alike; one inward reality bounds both.

sections.SUMMARY: A light that never sets holds brightness and darkness alike; a solitary inward reality, which both bound.

rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya (wonder) at darkness included, never opposed
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: unsetting light wedding bright and dark. All-containing marvel relished.

essence: He alone beings' own-nature; the world's abundance power cast as sovereignty.

sections.SUMMARY: That reality is each creature's own-nature, and the world's abundance is power cast in the shape of sovereignty.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: He alone, His alone. Identity relished.

essence: Power refuses parting; eternal identity, fire-sealed.

sections.SUMMARY: Power refuses any parting from its bearer — one eternally, as burning is one with fire.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is love-wonder: no parting ever wanted. Union relished.

essence: World-bearing His mark; whole mirrored by power in self-seeing.

sections.SUMMARY: Bhairava bears the world by mirroring it within His own seeing.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: the world carried in a glance. Mirroring relished.

essence: His goddess, grasp-eager, fills all exactly — never short, never over.

sections.SUMMARY: His goddess, grasp-eager, fills all exactly — never short, never over.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is love: Hers, hungry, exact. Belonging relished.

essence: Play-eager pair make-unmake varied worlds simultaneously, everywhere.

sections.SUMMARY: At play together, they make and unmake worlds in a single stroke.

rasa.sthayibhava: ullāsa (exuberant joy) at making-unmaking at once
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exuberant joy: play-eager, co-occurrent worlds. Play relished.

essence: Hardest deed, unsurpassed: autonomy, lordship, awareness-form in one.

sections.SUMMARY: The hardest deed belongs to Him and has no higher — and it is freedom, lordship, awareness-form in one.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: hardest, highest, freest, most aware — one. Equation relished.

essence: Partial shining marks inert; measure-evading awareness differs.

sections.SUMMARY: The inert is defined by shining only partially; awareness stands apart from it by escaping all measure.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: measure tried, awareness elsewhere. Uncontainability relished.

essence: Change self-abides: stood as nature, arrived without departing.

sections.SUMMARY: Change itself — every making and unmaking — rests inside the free one, distinguished by His own power, abiding as His nature rather than departing anywhere.

rasa.sthayibhava: śama (peace) at change standing still in self
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: makings resting, nowhere departing. Abiding relished.

essence: Variety totalized: extremes, three directions, outer-inner one list.

sections.SUMMARY: Variety is totalized first: every extreme, in all three directions, across outer worlds and their fragments and inner pleasure, pain, and mind.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: high low across, outer inner, complete. Totality relished.

essence: Mis-knowing described as freedom; bondage dreadful-to-fools, nothing second.

sections.SUMMARY: Then its cause is named: missing this freedom is itself freedom under description — and that mis-knowing is bondage, dreadful to the deluded.

rasa.sthayibhava: bhayānaka tempered: dread for fools, freedom beneath
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is tempered dread: terror named, freedom underneath. Naming relished.

essence: Three doors unranked; whichever arrival counts.

sections.SUMMARY: Three entries stand open — the sap of grace, the teacher's transmitted word, the Lord's scripture — and whichever one arrival comes through counts as arrival.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: grace, teacher, scripture — any door. Openness relished.

essence: Knowing-through is release from the Lord: fullness, living freedom, remembered.

sections.SUMMARY: Knowing reality to the bottom is release, a fullness belonging to the awakened, freedom lived while living, handed down as remembered teaching.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: known, released, full, living, remembered. Identity relished.

essence: Bondage-release undivided in nature and Lord, in truth.

sections.SUMMARY: Bondage and release both issue from the Lord's nature and do not come apart in Him — in truth, no split.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: bondage release, undivided, twice said. Doubled negation relished.

essence: Trident-lotus emblem bearing four powers; Bhairava all-nature, to be dwelt upon.

sections.SUMMARY: Thus — on will, art, knowledge, power, trident, lotus stayed — Bhairava, all things' own-nature, to be dwelt and weighed.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: stayed, stated, dwelt upon. Closing relished.

lines: Light never setting — bright powers, darknesses, all;
one, within, in whom each shine and shadow fall.
bod-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api | ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca

lines: He alone is every being's own-nature, the supreme Lord;
and the whole host of things — His power, Lordship-made.
bod-p02-v02.sanskrit_cite: sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ svabhāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ | bhāvajātaṃ hi tasyaiva śaktir īśvaratāmayī

lines: Power wants no parting from her bearer — never, ever;
the two are eternally one — as fire is one with burning.
bod-p03-v03.sanskrit_cite: śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati | tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva

lines: He alone is Bhairava, the world-bearing god;
in His own seeing's mirror stands the whole, mirrored by power.
bod-p04-v04.sanskrit_cite: sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ | svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam

lines: His alone is the goddess supreme, hungry to grasp His nature;
fullness in all beings — never little, never more.
bod-p05-v05.sanskrit_cite: tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā | pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam

lines: This god, with this goddess, forever eager for play's delight;
varied makings and unmakings He works at once — the all-pervading.
bod-p06-v06.sanskrit_cite: eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ | vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ

lines: What is hardest to do is His — and none is higher;
that itself is freedom, lordship, awareness-nature.
bod-p07-v07.sanskrit_cite: atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat | etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā

lines: To shine only in part — that is the mark of the inert;
awareness stands apart from the inert, for it cannot be measured.
bod-p08-v08.sanskrit_cite: paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam | jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate

lines: So of the free one, discerning by his own power,
makings and unmakings rest in his own self, standing as his nature.
bod-p09-v09.sanskrit_cite: evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ | svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ

lines: In them, variety runs to the uttermost — high, low, athwart;
worlds and their fragments, pleasure, pain, and mind.
bod-p10-v10.sanskrit_cite: teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat | bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā

lines: Not to know this is called His freedom — that is told;
and that itself is saṃsāra — to the deluded, a terror.
bod-p11-v11.sanskrit_cite: yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam | sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ

lines: From grace's sap, or the teacher's handed word,
or the Lord's own scripture — from wherever, it is reached.
bod-p12-v12.sanskrit_cite: tatprasādarasād eva gurvāgamata eva vā | śāstrād vā parameśasya yasmāt kasmād upāgatam

lines: To know the real through and through — release, from the supreme Lord;
that is the awakened's fullness: while living, free — as is remembered.
bod-p13-v13.sanskrit_cite: yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ | tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā

lines: Bondage and release, both from the Lord's own nature, never part;
in truth, in the Lord, there is no split.
bod-p14-v14.sanskrit_cite: etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ | na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare

lines: Thus, resting on will, art, knowledge, power, trident, lotus —
Bhairava, the own-nature of all things, is to be contemplated.
bod-p15-v15.sanskrit_cite: ittham icchākalājñānaśaktiśūlāmbujāśritaḥ | bhairavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ pariśīlyate

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta of all-containing light; vyabhicāri wonder at darkness included, never opposed; FIRST VERSE — sets the house voice (catalogue → oneness → fall; owner verdict required). Sanskrit-first: anastamita (NEVER-SETTING — kept; setting/not-setting is the doctrine); antarbahis (within — kept ‘within/in whom’, personal ground). Rows: 9 (bright-powers/darknesses catalogue held whole), 1 (‘fall’ closes — shine-and-shadow FALL: falling cadence), 5 (stotra-opening tread), 12 (śānta-fall close). Close: ‘shine and shadow fall’. Rupture: semicolon after ‘all’ (catalogue turns to oneness). Rejected: ‘never-fading’ — killed: setting is the doctrine-word; ‘in which’ smoothing — killed: ‘in whom’ keeps the personal ground; ‘gleam and gloom’ — killed: rhyme-twist smuggling tone. Read aloud: LIGHT-nev-er-SET-ting — BRIGHT-pow-ers, DARK-ness-es, ALL … ONE, with-IN, in-WHOM each SHINE and SHA-dow FALL.

reads_against.argmap: What never sets, and who dwells within it? → The all-containing One: light that never sets, holding bright and dark.
c1_essence: Unsetting light holds bright and dark alike; one inward reality bounds both.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of identity stated; vyabhicāri exultation (utsāha) at aloneness doubled. Sanskrit-first: sa eva (HE ALONE — eva insisted); aiśvarya-rūpa (LORDSHIP-MADE — sovereignty as the world's form). Rows: 9 (He-alone/His-alone echo), 1 (‘Lordship-made’ closes — formed-ness last), 3 (aloneness interlock: He-alone…His-alone). Close: ‘His power, Lordship-made’. Rupture: semicolon (who turns to what-all). Rejected: ‘His very own power’ — killed: doubles ‘alone’ weakly; ‘the universe’ — killed: ‘whole host of things’ kept inventoried; ‘is the self of all’ — killed: svabhāva kept own-nature (technical). Read aloud: HE a-LONE is EV-ery BE-ing's OWN-na-ture … WHOLE-host OF-things — HIS-pow-er, LORD-ship-MADE.

reads_against.argmap: Who is own-nature of all beings? → Identity, not process: He alone beings' nature; all things His Lordship-shaped power.
c1_essence: He alone beings' own-nature; the world's abundance power cast as sovereignty.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śṛṅgāra-adbhuta of inseparables; vyabhicāri love-wonder (rati-vismaya) at power never parting. Sanskrit-first: bheda-vāñchā nāsti (NO-WANT-of-difference — kept ‘wants no parting’; want denied, not parting described); vahni-dahana (FIRE-BURNING — dṛṣṭānta kept abstract). Rows: 9 (never-ever doubled — na kadācit hammered), 10 (fire/burning left standing, no gloss), 1 (‘burning’ closes — seal-image last). Close: ‘as fire is one with burning’. Rupture: em-dash (refusal turns to seal-image). Rejected: ‘like fire and its flame’ — killed: abstract kept abstract; ‘separate’ — killed: parting-want is the doctrine (want, not fact); ‘eternally united’ — killed: ‘eternally one’ kept (oneness, not union). Read aloud: POW-er WANTS no PART-ing FROM her BEAR-er — NEV-er, EV-er … the TWO are e-TERN-al-ly ONE — AS-fire IS-one WITH-burn-ING.

reads_against.argmap: Does power ever part from her bearer? → No-desire-for-difference, then eternal identity; fire-burning seals it.
c1_essence: Power refuses parting; eternal identity, fire-sealed.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta of world mirrored whole; vyabhicāri wonder at bearing-by-mirroring. Sanskrit-first: viśvabharita (WORLD-BEARING — mark first, per argmap character-then-mechanism); svadṛk (OWN-SEEING — kept technical); śakti-darpaṇa (power-mirror — manner IS the mark). Rows: 10 (mirror left standing, no gloss), 1 (‘mirrored by power’ closes — karaṇa last), 7 (Bhairava named L1 — mark before manner). Close: ‘mirrored by power’. Rupture: semicolon (mark turns to mechanism). Rejected: ‘in the mirror of His vision’ — killed: smoothing loses svadṛk; ‘carries’ — killed: bearing is BY-mirroring; ‘the universe’ — killed: ‘the whole’ kept (kṛtsna totality). Read aloud: HE a-LONE is BHAI-ra-va, the WORLD-bear-ing GOD … IN-his-OWN-see-ing's MIR-ror STANDS the WHOLE, MIR-rored BY-pow-ER.

reads_against.argmap: How does Bhairava bear the world? → Character then mechanism: world-bearing mark, power-mirroring manner.
c1_essence: World-bearing His mark; whole mirrored by power in self-seeing.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śṛṅgāra of bounded hunger; vyabhicāri love sharpened to exact fullness. Sanskrit-first: grahaṇa (GRASP — kept grasping; hunger of seizure, not curiosity); ūna-adhika-nishedha (NEITHER-less-NOR-more — two bounds kept). Rows: 11 (‘His alone’ — belonging pointed exactly where Sanskrit points), 9 (never-little/never-more pair), 1 (‘never more’ closes — exactness sealed). Close: ‘never little, never more’. Rupture: semicolon (whose turns to how-much). Rejected: ‘hungry to know’ — killed: grasp kept; ‘fills everything perfectly’ — killed: ‘in all beings’ located + two bounds kept; ‘the supreme goddess Hers’ — killed: awkward possession, ‘His alone is’ kept. Read aloud: HIS a-LONE IS the GOD-dess su-PREME, HUN-gry TO-grasp HIS-na-ture … FULL-ness IN-all-BE-ings — NEV-er LITT-le, NEV-er MORE.

reads_against.argmap: Whose is the goddess, and what does she want? → Belonging, bounded eagerness, exact fullness.
c1_essence: His goddess, grasp-eager, fills all exactly — never short, never over.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: ānanda-vīra of play; vyabhicāri exultant joy (ullāsa) at making-unmaking at once. Sanskrit-first: krīḍā-kautuka (PLAY-DELIGHT — kept dignified); yugapat (AT-ONCE — simultaneity kept); sṛṣṭi-saṃhāra (MAKINGS/UNMAKINGS — process nouns, not god-verbs). Rows: 9 (makings/unmakings pair + at-once), 8 (bright vowels throughout: eager/delight/makings — ānanda fills, no dark close), 1 (‘all-pervading’ closes — everywhere ends everywhere). Close: ‘the all-pervading’. Rupture: semicolon (mood turns to act — play-eager, therefore making). Rejected: ‘forever keen on fun’ — killed: dignity; ‘creates and destroys’ — killed: process nouns kept; ‘ frolics’ — killed: colloquial. Read aloud: THIS-god, WITH-this-GOD-dess, for-EV-er EA-ger FOR-play's de-LIGHT … VAR-ied MAK-ings AND-un-MAK-ings HE-works AT-once — THE-all-per-VAD-ing.

reads_against.argmap: What do god and goddess do together? → Mood then act: play-eager, therefore co-occurrent making-unmaking, everywhere.
c1_essence: Play-eager pair make-unmake varied worlds simultaneously, everywhere.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of equation; vyabhicāri exultation at five-said-once. Sanskrit-first: duṣkara (HARD-TO-DO — kept hard); pañca-pada-ekārtha (FIVE terms ONE referent — kept five, per C1). Rows: 9 (hardest/highest/freedom/lordship/awareness drummed — five-said-once), 1 (‘awareness-nature’ closes — jñāna-rūpa last of five), 3 (hardest=highest=freest: equation interlock). Close: ‘awareness-nature’. Rupture: semicolon (deed turns to equation). Rejected: ‘duty’ — killed: hardness is the doctrine; ‘liberation’ alone — killed: five kept five; ‘consciousness itself’ — killed: awareness-nature kept technical. Read aloud: WHAT is HARD-est TO-do IS-his — AND-none IS-high-ER … THAT it-SELF is FREE-dom, LORD-ship, a-WARE-ness-NA-ture.

reads_against.argmap: What five names share one referent? → Five terms, one referent: hard = unsurpassed = autonomy = lordship = awareness-form.
c1_essence: Hardest deed, unsurpassed: autonomy, lordship, awareness-form in one.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of criterion; vyabhicāri exultation at awareness uncontainable. Sanskrit-first: jaḍa (INERT — kept technical, not ‘unconscious’); aprameya (UNMEASURABLE — passive kept: cannot-be-measured). Rows: 1 (‘measured’ closes — what awareness escapes, named last), 9 (in-part vs stands-apart echo), 5 (criterion tread: mark L1, difference L2). Close: ‘it cannot be measured’. Rupture: semicolon (mark turns to difference). Rejected: ‘the unconscious’ — killed: technical kept; ‘transcends measure’ — killed: passive kept; ‘fragmentary’ for ‘in part’ — killed: ekadeśa kept plain. Read aloud: TO-shine ON-ly IN-part — THAT is the MARK of the in-ERT … a-WARE-ness STANDS a-PART … FOR it CAN-not BE-mea-SURED.

reads_against.argmap: How is awareness told apart from the inert? → Mark then difference: partial shining vs measure-evading awareness.
c1_essence: Partial shining marks inert; measure-evading awareness differs.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta of abiding; vyabhicāri peace (śama) at change standing still in self. Sanskrit-first: svātantryāt (BY-OWN-POWER — kept; discerning's instrument named); sthiti (STANDING — kept; standing IS the doctrine); viśrānti (REST — kept). Rows: 1 (‘standing as his nature’ closes), 9 (makings/unmakings — same words as v6: terminological consistency kept), 12 (śānta-settle: rest…standing). Close: ‘standing as his nature’. Rupture: comma after ‘power’ (discerning turns to resting). Rejected: ‘dwell’ — killed: rest kept; ‘are his essence’ — killed: standing-as-nature kept standing; ‘the autonomous one’ — killed: ‘the free one’ kept (house word). Read aloud: SO of the FREE-one, dis-CERN-ing BY his OWN-pow-ER … MAK-ings AND-un-MAK-ings REST in his OWN-self, STAND-ing AS his NA-ture.

reads_against.argmap: Where do makings and unmakings stand? → Thus-therefore: self-abiding change, stood not made.
c1_essence: Change self-abides: stood as nature, arrived without departing.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta of totality; vyabhicāri wonder at all-directions-all-things listed. Sanskrit-first: paryanta (UTTERMOST — kept; running-to-the-end is the doctrine); ūrdhva-adhas-tiryak (HIGH-LOW-ATHWART — three directions kept technical). Rows: 9 (total inventory kept UNCOMPRESSED — completeness IS the point per C1), 2 (direction-compounds unpacked), 1 (‘mind’ closes — inner last: outer→inner order kept). Close: ‘pleasure, pain, and mind’. Rupture: em-dash (extremes turn to inventory). Rejected: ‘all extremes’ compression — killed: uncompressed IS completeness; ‘sideways’ — killed: athwart technical; ‘beings’ for ‘things’ — killed: bhāva kept things. Read aloud: IN-them, va-RI-e-ty RUNS to the UTT-er-most — HIGH, LOW, a-THWART … WORLDS and their FRAG-ments, PLEA-sure, PAIN, and MIND.

reads_against.argmap: How far does variety run? → Total inventory, uncompressed: completeness is the point.
c1_essence: Variety totalized: extremes, three directions, outer-inner one list.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: karuṇa-bhaya of bondage named; vyabhicāri tempered dread (terror for fools, freedom beneath). Sanskrit-first: ajñāna (NOT-TO-KNOW — kept verbal; the bondage-act, not a thing); mūḍha-bhaya (FOOL'S-TERROR — dread located: to the deluded). Rows: 1 (‘terror’ closes — bhaya lands last, dread where it belongs), 9 (freedom/saṃsāra equation pair — mis-knowing IS freedom, bondage IS terror), 12 declined — no settling; dread stays dread for fools. Close: ‘a terror’. Rupture: semicolon (equation turns to identification).
